seoTitle: About this project — ABC Company demo
seoDescription: How this demo website was rebuilt: a free Git-based CMS, a safer contact form, Lighthouse 97–100, and self-hosting on a small server.
title: About this project
intro: ABC Company is not a real company. This is a demo website I built to show how I make business websites: fast, safe, easy for the owner to edit, and cheap to run.
resultsIntro: I first built this site in 2025. In November 2026 I went back over all of it: I fixed security holes, made it much faster, and moved it off paid services.

results.label: Time until the main content shows on a phone
Known security problems in the packages used

resultsNote: Measured with Google Lighthouse in phone mode, on the same computer and the same test, November 2026. On computers every page now scores 100 in all four Lighthouse categories.

features.title: Every word is editable
features.text: All texts, pictures, case studies and team members are edited in a simple online editor at /admin. Changes are saved to GitHub and go live in a few minutes. No database, no monthly CMS fee.

features.title: A contact form that is hard to abuse
features.text: Every field is checked, emails are plain text so nothing harmful can be slipped in, a hidden trap catches spam bots, and each visitor can only send a few messages per hour.

features.title: Fast on slow phones
features.text: Pages are built ahead of time, pictures are in the small WebP format and sized for the screen, and the first view needs no waiting for extra files.

features.title: Built for everyone
features.text: Readable colours, clear page structure for screen readers, and animations that switch off for people who prefer less motion.

features.title: Runs on my own server
features.text: The site runs in a small, locked-down Docker box on my own server. GitHub tests and builds every change, then delivers it automatically.
